# Worker Readiness Protocol (replicated coordination between the coordinator on g1-server and one agent per worker)

This folder is in the shared worktree: what a worker writes here reaches the coordinator within seconds and the other way round. Re-read this file at the start of every round; the coordinator changes it.

`W` = this folder. `<origin>` = the `originId` in `<worktree>/.cache/f/machine.json` (e.g. `g1-m03`). Worktree: macOS `~/Documents/semio`, Linux `~/semio`, Windows `C:\semio`.

## Rules for the worker agent
- Change no file outside `W/workers/<origin>/`. No build code, no fixes: the coordinator's agents fix in one place; you observe and report. (Several workers fixing the same files last night cost hours.)
- No git command that changes anything, no pkill/killall, no sudo, never print tokens. Kill only processes you started.
- One graph command at a time on the machine (`repo run`, `repo show`, `repo cargo`, the bootstrap): they queue behind each other.
- Write numbers as measured; say "not measured" otherwise.

## Round
1. Read `W/workers/<origin>/next.md` if it exists (instructions for this machine only), else `W/ROUND.md` (instructions for all). Each has a line `round: <n>`. If you already reported round n (`W/workers/<origin>/round-<n>.md` exists), wait: check every 60 seconds for a higher round, at most 6 hours, then stop.
2. Do what the round says. Unless it says otherwise the round is: run `W/native-bootstrap.sh "$HOME/native-bootstrap-round-<n>.log"` once, in the foreground.
3. Report in `W/workers/<origin>/round-<n>.md`: machine (memory, free disk, OS), code digest of the replica daemon (`status`), start and end time, `native_rc`, every failed task with its first error line verbatim and the 15 lines before it, the `[capacity]` and `graph:` lines verbatim, peak resident size seen (sample `ps -axo rss,command | sort -nr | head -3` every 30 s), wall time per phase. Copy the last 200 lines of the log to `W/workers/<origin>/round-<n>.tail.txt`.
4. Write `W/workers/<origin>/state.json`: `{"origin":"<origin>","round":<n>,"native_rc":<code>,"ready":<true|false>,"failed":["<task>",…],"at":"<UTC time>"}`. `ready` is true only when `native_rc` is 0 and `<worktree>/.cache/f/native-bootstrap.done` exists.
5. When ready: run `repo preflight --lang en` and the replica `status`, add both to the report, and stop. Otherwise go to 1.
instructions:
round: 6

For g1-m08: follow `ROUND.md` round 6 like every other machine.
global_round:
round: 6

Every machine. If an earlier round is still running: one SIGINT, write its report, then start. (g1-m02: if your try is inside the setup tasks, let it finish first and report its failed tasks.)

Round 5 results: g1-m03 got past the graph step and ran `workspace:setup` to the end on 16 GB (12 tasks passed, 7 failed, no memory problem); g1-m01 restored a whole generation from the fleet in 17 s; g1-m02 reached the setup tasks. What stopped the others is fixed in the tree since 19:30 UTC (untested on a worker, that is this round):
- macOS denial of the graph service (`fstatat failed (EPERM)`, reference e07192d7) on g1-m01, m02, m03, m07, m08: the service is now a login job whose program is the launcher, so one consent holds. NEW: `native_rc=4` (or a `repo` command ending with 4) means "consent missing", not a failure: do not retry; copy the text and stop the round with `"consent"` in your report.
- `ENOENT … build-input-closures/<hash>.json` (g1-m01, g1-m06): the load repairs itself (line `closureRepaired`); if the same ENOENT survives a try, run `repo cache gc --area=graph-inference` once and try again.
- Not fixed yet (in work): the seven task failures of g1-m03 (`cpp-setup`, `plugin-registry:generate`, `deps-build-tools`, `framework-os-mcp-rs:build`, and `deps-cargo`/`deps-trunk`/`deps-tools` when another machine edits build code during the run). Expect them; we need to know whether anything ELSE fails.

Do this:
1. Mac workers, before the run: do the read-only checks of `W/ROUND-NOTE-P6.md` sections 1, 2 and 4 after your first `repo` command of the round and put the outputs into the report (section 3 only if a denial or exit 4 occurs). All machines: replica code digest, `ps` lines of `repo service host` processes, last 8 lines of `.cache/f/sidecars/build-agent.log`.
2. Run `W/native-bootstrap.sh "$HOME/native-bootstrap-round-6.log"`.
3. Try again (at most 8 tries, `…-round-6-try-<k>.log`): after `native_rc=75` or a fleet refusal text (wait 2 minutes); after a hard stop (wait 3 minutes); after a try that ended in nx task failures of which at least one is `stale build.closure.source-differs` (wait 2 minutes: another machine edited build code); after the ENOENT case above (after the gc). Do NOT try again after exit 4, or when two tries in a row fail with the same task errors and none of them is `source-differs`.
4. Hard stops: a process of the run above 8 GB resident; macOS `kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level` 4 in two samples in a row (30 s apart), or 2 in six samples in a row; Linux PSI memory `full avg10` 20 % or more in two samples in a row.
5. Report per try: the graph lines (`taken from the fleet`, `inferred here`, `waiting for the fleet`, `restored`, `closureRepaired`), and for the setup tasks the list of succeeded, failed and not-run tasks with, for every failed task, the first error line and 15 lines before it. If `native_rc=0` and the marker exists: `ready: true`, then `repo preflight --lang en` and the replica `status` as in `PROTOCOL.md` step 5, and stop.
